title: T104 (Tinyana) PNC - Rabbeinu Loved the Avoidois Peshutois — Zemiroth Shabbos and the Way of the Pashut Yid
hebrewTitle: אהבת רבינו את העבודות הפשוטות — זמירות שבת והאנשים הכשרים הפשוטים
author: Pettek Nanach

beginner.en: **Hayah oheiv me'oid es ha-avoidois ha-peshutois shel stam bnei adam, ha-anashim ha-peshutim ha-keshairim.** Rabbeinu *deeply loved* the simple avoidois of the *plain kosher Yidden* — *ha-anashim ha-peshutim ha-keshairim*. **Ve-hayah oheiv me'oid mi she-yachoil lomar harbeih techinois u-vakashois be-toich ha-sidurim ha-gedoilim, ke-derech ha-hamoin am ha-keshairim.** He loved one who could *say many techinois u-vakashois inside the big siddurim*, *like the way of the kosher hamoin*. **Ve-hayah mazhir u-mochi'ach osanu kammah pe'amim, le-zameir zemirois be-Shabbos** — and he was *makpid u-ko'eis me'oid* on one who was *chocham be-einav* and would not strain himself to *sing zemirois on Shabbos u-be-motza'ei Shabbos* or other *avoidois peshutois*. **Ki ikar ha-Yahadus hu bi-feshitus u-vi-temimus gemurah, bli shum chochmois.** The *whole of Yahadus* is in *peshitus and temimus gemurah, without any chochmois at all*.

intermediate.en: **Ahavas Rabbeinu**: *ha-avoidois ha-peshutois shel stam bnei adam ha-keshairim*. *Hayah oheiv mi she-yachoil le-harboth techinois ba-sidurim ha-gedoilim ke-derech ha-hamoin am ha-keshairim*. **Tochachah**: al ha-chochmim be-einav she-loi mis'amtzim *le-zameir zemirois be-Shabbos u-be-motza'ei Shabbos*. **Klal yesoid**: *ikar ha-Yahadus = peshitus u-temimus gemurah, bli shum chochmois*.

scholarly.he: [T2:104א] רבינו אהב את העבודות הפשוטות של אנשים פשוטים כשרים. הזהיר על אמירת זמירות בשבת ובמוצש"ק; הקפיד על "חכמים בעיניהם." עיקר היהדות = פשיטות ותמימות גמורה.

beginner.en: **Ve-gam hu be-atzmoi, zichroinoi li-vrachah, koidem she-higi'a lo ha-chola'as ha-koveid she-nis-talek al yado — koidem la-zeh, kol yamav hayah me-zameir zemirois harbeih be-chol Shabbos ve-Shabbos u-be-motza'ei Shabbos.** Reb Nosson notes the personal example: *until the kovedness of his cholaas (TB) overtook him at the end of his life — Rabbeinu himself, all his days, sang zemirois at length, every Shabbos and every motza'ei Shabbos*. The *teacher of the peshutim* was, himself, a *zemiros-singer*.

intermediate.en: **Edus Reb Nosson**: *Rabbeinu atzmoi — kol yamav me-zameir zemirois harbeih be-chol Shabbos u-be-motza'ei Shabbos*, ad koidem ha-cholaas ha-koveid (TB) she-nis-talek al yadah. *Ha-mekareiv le-peshitus — atzmoi me-zameir*.

scholarly.he: [T2:104ב] רבינו עצמו כל ימיו זימר זמירות הרבה בשבת ובמוצ"ש (עד החולאת הכבד = שחפת).
